description: Validates a complete character card and saves it as card.json and card.md. Returns the id and file paths (use character_get to show the card). Use overwrite: true with meta.slug = id to update a saved card.

biography.description: Short biography, 80-200 words: a chronological story from birth to the start of the story, grounded in real-feeling personal experience. It must dramatise the wound.

connection_to_past.description: How the character is tied to past events of this world.

contradictions.description: Secondary characters who reveal contradictory sides.

behavior.description: Which side of the hero they reveal.

daily_life.description: How they shop, eat, love, work, exercise, pray.

decision_style.description: How their decision-making looks visually, and under pressure.

distance_from_peers.description: How far they've gone compared to people from their hometown.

key_locations.description: Key places (home, street, workplace) with one telling detail each.

best_and_worst.description: Best and worst things that can happen in this world.

boundaries.description: The edges of their world: where it ends, what lies beyond, what is forbidden.

good_and_bad.description: What counts as good and bad here.

survival_vs_comfort.description: Survival or manicured nails — what matters more here.

who_rules.description: Who rules this world and who makes the important decisions.

central_paradox.description: The contradiction that makes them vivid: the wound landing on this temperament, so their best and worst traits are two faces of it.

dna.description: DNA: what they were born or made with, the bottom layer of the core. Temperament + innate appearance.

ancestry.description: Lineage or origin they were born from; for made beings, who made them and from what.

body_plan.description: How the body is built: biped, quadruped, serpentine, winged, many-limbed, amorphous...

born_differences.description: Body differences they were born or made with: a missing or extra limb, heterochromia, a birthmark... Rare: usually empty. Injuries and wear from life are marks in look, not here.

items.description: One innate body difference and how it shows.

build_tendency.description: Innate build: 0 lean and wiry → 100 heavy and solid.

colors.description: Natural colours of the body, before life changed them (dye, sun, scars).

part.description: Body part as one lowercase English word (skin, hair, eyes, scales, stag-hide...); it stays the same in translations, so life events can name it.

covering.description: What covers the body and its natural texture: skin, fur, scales, feathers, bark, plating; hair type if any.

face.description: Face or head features they were born with, one line.

frame.description: Innate proportions. For a non-humanoid body, the closest humanoid reading (the concept sheet is a humanoid A-pose).

arms.description: Arm length vs average: 0.9 short, 1.1 long.

head_heights.description: Standing height in head lengths, as drawn in the art style: ~4 small child, ~6 teen or stocky, 7-7.5 average adult, 8+ tall and elongated, 9.5-10 fashion-sketch extreme.

hips.description: Hip width vs an average adult of their kind: 1 average, 0.8 narrow, 1.3 wide.

legs.description: Leg length vs average: 0.9 short-legged, 1.1 long-legged.

shoulders.description: Shoulder width vs an average adult of their kind: 1 average, 0.8 narrow, 1.3 broad.

sex.description: Sex they were born or made with, or 'none' (gender as presented lives in description).

temperament.description: Innate temperament: six scales. Take the rolled numbers unless the brief fixes them; the wound lands on this temperament.

agreeableness.description: rebel, contrarian, hard to sway (0) → soft, accommodating, goes along (100).

plasticity.description: How far life can move it: the value stays within born ± plasticity/2.

shows.description: One line: how this shows in this particular being.

value.description: Born value, 0 = rebel, contrarian, hard to sway, 100 = soft, accommodating, goes along.

conscientiousness.description: chaotic, impulsive, lives by chance (0) → orderly, disciplined, lives by a plan (100).

plasticity.description: How far life can move it: the value stays within born ± plasticity/2.

shows.description: One line: how this shows in this particular being.

value.description: Born value, 0 = chaotic, impulsive, lives by chance, 100 = orderly, disciplined, lives by a plan.

extraversion.description: withdrawn, seeks solitude, recharges alone (0) → outgoing, seeks company, draws energy from others (100).

plasticity.description: How far life can move it: the value stays within born ± plasticity/2.

shows.description: One line: how this shows in this particular being.

value.description: Born value, 0 = withdrawn, seeks solitude, recharges alone, 100 = outgoing, seeks company, draws energy from others.

neuroticism.description: calm, even, cheerful by default (0) → anxious, moody, gloomy by default (100).

plasticity.description: How far life can move it: the value stays within born ± plasticity/2.

shows.description: One line: how this shows in this particular being.

value.description: Born value, 0 = calm, even, cheerful by default, 100 = anxious, moody, gloomy by default.

openness.description: sticks to the familiar, practical (0) → curious, creative, drawn to art, music and the new (100).

plasticity.description: How far life can move it: the value stays within born ± plasticity/2.

shows.description: One line: how this shows in this particular being.

value.description: Born value, 0 = sticks to the familiar, practical, 100 = curious, creative, drawn to art, music and the new.

sensitivity.description: dandelion: barely moved by good or bad surroundings (0) → orchid: shaped hard by both bad and good surroundings (100).

plasticity.description: How far life can move it: the value stays within born ± plasticity/2.

shows.description: One line: how this shows in this particular being.

value.description: Born value, 0 = dandelion: barely moved by good or bad surroundings, 100 = orchid: shaped hard by both bad and good surroundings.

dramatic_question.description: The yes/no question the story answers about them, e.g. 'Will she ring the bell for the man who drowned her town?'

lie.description: The false belief the wound taught them, in their own words.

self_story.description: The wound as they tell it to themselves: first person, in their voice, only what they know or believe. No hindsight, no future, nothing only the author knows (if they took a joke for an honour, it is an honour here). A playing character keeps this in mind instead of the wound.

spark_links.description: How the surprising elements (job, world, archetype, look) grew out of the wound and the DNA — the 'inevitable but unexpected' logic.

truth.description: The truth they must learn — the need, stated as a belief.

wound.description: The formative wound everything grows from, as the author knows it (the character may not).

biggest_disappointment.description: Biggest disappointment / heartache — fears grow from this.

cultural_background.description: The culture they grew up in and how it shows (their lineage lives in core.dna).

gender.description: Gender as they present it (sex at birth lives in core.dna).

hobbies.description: Hobbies, skills, interests, collections, sports, music, weekends.

life_events.description: Exactly 3 formative life events. One of them is the wound itself (weight 'wound'), with what it changed in them.

changes.description: What this event made of them: which characteristics it changed, to what and how — a hard childhood made them more anxious, a fever turned their hair white, a growth trial stretched their legs. The DNA itself never changes (it keeps what they were born with); this records what life made of it. Leave out what it didn't touch.

characteristic.description: Which characteristic it changed in them, by its name in core.dna: temperament.extraversion, frame.legs, colors.hair (a part named in colors), covering, face, build_tendency...

how.description: How and why the event changed it.

to.description: What it became after the event: a number for a scale (0-100, within born ± plasticity/2), a proportion (in the frame's range) or the build; #RRGGBB for a colour; text otherwise.

effect.description: How it changed them, given the temperament it landed on.

weight.description: How much it shaped them: 'wound' for the formative hurt (exactly one event), 'major' for a turning point, 'minor' for something small that still left a trace.

missing.description: What is missing from their life; what would make it perfect.

most_valued.description: What they value most in life.

name_meaning.description: Why this name: etymology, metaphor, sound.

physical.description: How the body looks NOW: the DNA plus what life did (weight, age, sun, dye). Marks, movement and clothing live in the look section.

secret_dream.description: Secret dream, and how they see their future.

world_events.description: How events in the wider world affect them, inside and out.

manner.description: How they talk: rhythm, register, accent, verbal habits.

sample_lines.description: 2-4 lines of dialogue in their voice.

ending.description: Where they end up — master of two worlds (even if they die).

threshold.description: What pushes them into the other world.

void.description: The emptiness nothing in that world can fill.

courage_source.description: What motivates them to push through the fear.

mask.description: How they hide fear / the face they show the world.

overcoming.description: How they overcome it (one of the classic patterns, made specific).

arc_goal.description: The inner arc, ideally phrased like one of the popular arc goals.

conflicting_goals.description: How want and need are (or become) mutually exclusive, forcing a choice.

goal_climax.description: How the goal peaks at the story climax.

need.description: Inner need that never changes; carries the theme.

scene_goal_example.description: An example of a concrete goal in one scene.

want.description: Conscious external goal (can change during the story).

first_appearance.description: How we meet them — as early as possible, in a scene that shows who they are.

flaws.description: At least 2 flaws, ideally from different categories.

how_it_shows.description: How it shows on screen / page.

jeopardy.description: The danger (emotional, physical) that makes the audience worry for them.

methods.description: At least 3 ways the audience bonds with the character.

superpower.description: What they can do that is amazing (can be mundane-but-exceptional).

sympathy_hook.description: The moment/situation that makes us feel for them early on.

vulnerability.description: The kryptonite that balances the superpower.

look.description: The look, derived from the story: every element must show a part of it.

art_style.description: Art style for the concept, e.g. 'stylized 3D, painterly textures'.

blocking.description: Zone colours for the concept block-in (#RRGGBB): they steer the concept image's colours. Strongly recommended.

accessories.description: Worn items that must appear consistently in every view (a coil on one shoulder, a belt, a backpack).

item.description: What the blob is, e.g. 'coiled rope' — named in the prompt so it isn't drawn as armour.

where.description: Where on the body (the character's own left/right).

bottom.description: Main colour of the lower body and legs.

footwear_left.description: Footwear on the character's LEFT foot.

footwear_right.description: Footwear on the character's RIGHT foot.

hair.description: Hair colour now: the natural one as age and life changed it (grey, dye, sun).

skin.description: Skin (or fur / scales) colour now: the natural one as age and life changed it.

top.description: Main colour of the upper body and arms (sleeves).

body.description: Posture and asymmetries on top of the frame (core.dna.frame, as life events changed it). Not idealized: symmetry is rare.

head_tilt.description: Habitual head cant: -1 strongly toward their LEFT shoulder, 0 straight, 1 toward their RIGHT.

shoulder_tilt.description: Which shoulder sits lower: -1 their LEFT much lower, 0 level, 1 their RIGHT much lower.

stoop.description: 0 upright, 0.5 rounded back, 1 heavy stoop with the head sunk forward between the shoulders.

why.description: Where this posture and these asymmetries come from (work, injury, age, habit; or built in, if so), each tied to the story.

marks.description: Marks on the body, each with an origin in the biography.

mark.description: Scar, tattoo, prosthetic, wear... Acquired only: innate differences live in core.dna.

origin.description: Which event in their life caused it.

idle_pose.description: How they stand or sit when nothing happens.

under_stress.description: How their body changes under pressure.

outfit.description: Outfit pieces from inner to outer.

why.description: What it says about them: sociology, world, defense, history.

meaning.description: What this colour carries in their story.

perfection.description: How polished vs. flawed they look, and why (neglect, pride, poverty, vanity, discipline...).

props.description: Other props, besides the signature item (may be empty).

shape_language.description: Dominant shapes (round / square / triangle / mixed) and why they follow from the core.

how_carried.description: How they carry, wear or use it; how it changes over the arc.

item.description: The one object everyone associates with them.

story.description: Where it comes from in their backstory and what it means to them.

silhouette.description: Silhouette hook recognisable in black fill — and which genre-stock look it deliberately avoids.

story_reads.description: Exactly 3 things a stranger understands about them in 3 seconds, without a word.

stranger_view.description: What a stranger sees in the first seconds, as plain observation in 3-6 sentences: height and build, face, hair, clothes, what they carry, how they stand and move. Only what eyes can see in ordinary light: no names, owners, origins, histories, meanings or anything hidden (hair hanging over one ear is seen; that the ear is deaf is not). Characters who meet them know only this.

turnaround_notes.description: What the concept artist must not miss (asymmetry, sides, scale).

brief.description: The user's original brief, verbatim, when mode = 'brief'.

concept_image.description: Path or URL of the user's own concept image, when they gave one (character_create returns it). character_pick imports it as the winner's concept.

group.description: Variant-set id shared by competing variants of one concept.

logline.description: One sentence: who they are, what they want, what stands in the way.

mode.description: 'random' if built from a rolled seed, 'brief' if from a user description.

seed.description: Seed returned by character_create, when one was used.

slug.description: Optional URL-safe id (lowercase-latin-with-dashes). Derived from the name if omitted.

variant.description: Variant letter within the group (A, B, C...).

summary.description: One or two sentences: why it won or lost.

childhood.description: Family climate in childhood and how it shapes them now.

emotional_baseline.description: Overall emotional state: broken / fresh / cynical / positive...

inner_monologue.description: Exactly 3 lines of inner voice, first person, in quotes-free form.

insecurity.description: What they feel is wrong with them and hide.

interprets_experience.description: Do they blame themselves, or never take responsibility?

psychological_issues.description: Neuroses, obsessions, panic, anger, memory problems...

active.description: What they are like fully committed.

passive.description: What they are like with no goal.

strongest_trigger.description: What provokes their strongest emotion (scar, shameful past...).

visual_device.description: How to SHOW their inner state on screen / in-game / on page.

best_trait.description: ONE thing they do better than anyone in the world.

others_say.description: What other characters say about them (quotes).

personality.description: What they are like in life now, as a person: mood, energy, how they are with others (alone or in company, leader or follower, rebel or conformist), their social life and what they love. The DNA temperament after the wound and the life events; a stranger should know them from this paragraph.

worst_trait.description: ONE trait that could bring their downfall.

food.description: Food preferences or an unusual way of ordering.

love_style.description: How they show love; romantic quirks; preferred relationships.

shopping.description: Where and how they shop (thrift store, boutique, black market...).

sore_spot.description: A strange small thing that upsets them or presses a sore spot.

spirituality.description: How they practice spirituality: rituals, meditation, faith, superstition.

tastes.description: Strange taste in music, food, films, shows.

vehicle.description: What they drive (or ride) and how.

quirks.description: At least 5 specific, filmable quirks that make this archetype unique.

overwrite.description: Overwrite the character with the same id instead of creating name-2.

name: character_save
title: Validate and save character card
